  1. AD-HOC NEWS / Futuriom · Sep 23, 2026 · Industry news

    HPE Reports 36% Networking Orders Growth; Juniper Integration On Track

    Hewlett Packard Enterprise reported networking revenue grew 10% year over year in Q3 FY2026, with networking orders rising 36%, and cloud and AI orders up about 75%. HPE linked the integration to 14-17% networking growth in fiscal 2027. The strong order momentum reflects accelerating demand for AI-native networking infrastructure from the Juniper acquisition.

    Sep 24, 2026 edition

  2. Globe Newswire · Sep 23, 2026 · Vendor release

    D&H Distributing Expands Relationship with HPE; Chosen as a North American Distributor of HPE Networking

    D&H Distributing extended its distribution partnership with HPE on September 23, 2026, gaining access to the HPE Networking portfolio including HPE Juniper Networking routers and switches, with full availability to partners by end of September 2026. This integration adds HPE Networking to D&H's Advanced Solutions+ ecosystem, giving partners access to HPE's networking, cloud, and AI portfolios along with D&H's training, enablement, and 24/7 support.

    Sep 23, 2026 edition

  3. Digitalisation World · Sep 16, 2026

    Juniper Networks Introduces Apstra Freeform for Multivendor Data Center Automation

    Juniper Networks expanded its Apstra intent-based networking platform with Freeform capability, enabling enterprises to manage and automate data center operations regardless of topology and protocols. This removes architectural constraints from intent-driven networking, allowing customers to move beyond rigid fabric designs to flexible, multi-topology environments across data centers.

    Sep 19, 2026 edition

  4. TechNode · Sep 9, 2026

    Oracle Plans HPE Juniper Rollout Across Global AI Data Centers

    Oracle plans to extend HPE Juniper networking across its global AI data centers as OCI superclusters scale. The multiyear deployment covers routing, switching equipment, support services and financing. HPE raised its fiscal 2026 revenue growth forecast to 34%-37% after record quarterly sales driven by AI servers and networking demand.

    Sep 10, 2026 edition
